narrative:
Franklin County has 904,731 registered voters, with 11.0% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 14.1% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 62.2%, a pronounced Democratic lean of 48.0 percentage points. Millennials are the largest generational cohort at 32.6% of registrants. Registration is trending bluer in younger age cohorts (1990s–2000s births lean +10.5% D−R vs +8.3% for 1950s–60s cohorts).
